facts: One upright round electroscope housing on a stem and spread-foot base; a horizontal rectangular metal top plate joins the central vertical rod through a neck.
Five illustrated cross-shaped plus marks are visible in the top plate. They are symbolic markings, not five measured elementary charges.
Inside the round housing a thin inclined member crosses the central rod; its upper end is to the right and lower end to the left. The central rod continues below the crossing.
A fan of short unnumbered strokes occupies the lower-left interior; it is not a readable calibrated scale.
No glass, hand, numerical angle, voltage, charge magnitude, or material label is printed.
uncertainties: Exact short fan-stroke count is not treated as scientific data or a certified calibrated inventory; modern spacing is explicitly unmeasured.
modernAdditions: Clean line widths and fan spacing; no new measurement.

facts: The same round electroscope, horizontal charged top plate, vertical rod, neck, stem and spread feet remain.
A long thick rectangular glass member lies above the top plate with a visible separating gap; a drawn hand holds its right end from the right.

Repeated stacked cross-like upper marks and short horizontal lower marks are visible in the left part of the glass. Seven paired marking groups can be distinguished; they are schematic polarization signs, not a count of physical charges.
Five illustrated plus marks remain in the metal plate.
The thin inclined internal member is much closer to the vertical rod than in fig128, but not identical to it; the lower-left unnumbered fan remains.
No transfer arrow, contacting glass-metal junction, measured gap, calibrated angle, or numerical reading is printed.
uncertainties: Small irregularities in the polarization glyphs and unnumbered fan are not interpreted as additional labels or a calibrated measurement.
modernAdditions: English Glass (no contact) label, justified by frozen prose.
Simplified deterministic hand outline and apparatus outline; no operating instruction.
Cross/bar marker alignment regularized without making it measured charge data.

facts: One solid circular outline encloses one filled central nucleus point and one filled electron point on the upper-right circumference.
The upper electron is labelled -e; the nucleus has the recognizable charge relation +q=e.
A dashed oblique diameter runs from the lower-left circumference through the nucleus to the upper-right circumference. Its opposite ends are labelled 2 and 1 respectively.
The dashed diameter is not an arrow; no speed arrow, period, orbit count, distance or extra particle is printed.
uncertainties: A tiny descender under the central italic q is not promoted to a new subscript, vector mark, or numerical label.
modernAdditions: English Source classical model notice from the frozen modern qualifications.
Centered clean schematic circle and opposite points; no inferred orbit radius or measured trajectory.

facts: One circular outer guide encloses one filled central nucleus point, labelled +q.

Twelve small segmented/dashed outlined negative markers appear around the outer circumference, each with a short minus stroke. They are a series of illustrated positions, not twelve simultaneous physical electrons.
The rightmost negative marker has an external -q label.
No motion arrow, probability scale, angular values, charge-density gradient or exact time/count is printed.
modernAdditions: English Source classical model notice; no claim of measured or quantum electron paths.
Even schematic angular spacing and clean dashed marker outlines, explicitly modern and unmeasured.

facts: One connected two-lobed outline has a narrowed waist rather than two disconnected circles.
The left lobe contains a plus sign and is labelled Na below; the right lobe contains a minus sign and is labelled Cl below.
There are exactly two represented ion locations, with left-positive/right-negative ownership.
No electron-transfer arrow, other lattice ions, numerical bond distance or separate electrons are printed.
modernAdditions: English Ion-pair model label, consistent with full frozen context rather than a model of the whole solid crystal.

facts: Two filled points lie left and right on one joining straight segment, with the left point positive and the right point negative.
The labels are +|q| under the left point, -|q| under the right point, and symbolic l above the joining segment.
The line has no arrowhead. No electric-field arrow, dipole-moment arrow, other charges, distance value or computed answer is printed.
